```bash
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../constants/app_categories.dart';

class AddTransactionScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AddTransactionScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<AddTransactionScreen> createState() => _AddTransactionScreenState();
}

class _AddTransactionScreenState extends State<AddTransactionScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  bool     _isExpense    = true;
  String   _category     = 'Groceries';
  DateTime _date         = DateTime.now();
  late AnimationController _animCtrl;
  late Animation<double>   _fadeAnim;

  final _amountCtrl   = TextEditingController();
  final _merchantCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _noteCtrl     = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _animCtrl = AnimationController(
      vsync   : this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
    );
    _fadeAnim = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _animCtrl,
      curve : Curves.easeInOut,
    );
    _animCtrl.forward();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _animCtrl.dispose();
    _amountCtrl.dispose();
    _merchantCtrl.dispose();
    _noteCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  List<AppCategory> get _categories =>
    _isExpense ? AppCategories.expense : AppCategories.income;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      appBar: _buildAppBar(),
      body  : FadeTransition(
        opacity: _fadeAnim,
        child  : SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child  : Column(
            children: [
              _buildToggle(),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              _buildAmountCard(),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _buildMerchantField(),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _buildCategoryPicker(),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _buildDatePicker(),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _buildNoteField(),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              _buildSaveButton(),
              const SizedBox(height: 32),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  AppBar _buildAppBar() {
    return AppBar(
      backgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      elevation      : 0,
      centerTitle    : true,
      leading        : IconButton(
        icon     : const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_rounded,
          color: AppColors.textPrimary),
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
      ),
      title: Text('Add Transaction',
        style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
          color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          fontSize  : 18,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildToggle() {
    return Container(
      padding   : const EdgeInsets.all(4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color       : AppColors.cardBg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border      : Border.all(color: AppColors.cardBorder),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          _toggleBtn('💸  Expense', true,  AppColors.expense),
          _toggleBtn('💰  Income',  false, AppColors.income),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _toggleBtn(String label, bool isExpense, Color color) {
    final active = _isExpense == isExpense;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => setState(() {
          _isExpense = isExpense;
          _category  = isExpense ? 'Groceries' : 'Salary';
        }),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration : const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
          padding  : const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: active ? LinearGradient(
              colors: [color.withOpacity(0.8), color.withOpacity(0.5)],
            ) : null,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            boxShadow: active ? [
              BoxShadow(
                color     : color.withOpacity(0.3),
                blurRadius: 8,
              ),
            ] : null,
          ),
          child: Text(label,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style    : GoogleFonts.poppins(
              color     : active ? Colors.white : AppColors.textHint,
              fontWeight: active ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
              fontSize  : 14,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAmountCard() {
    final color = _isExpense ? AppColors.expense : AppColors.income;
    return Container(
      width  : double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin : Alignment.topLeft,
          end   : Alignment.bottomRight,
          colors: [AppColors.cardBg, color.withOpacity(0.08)],
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: color.withOpacity(0.3)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(color: color.withOpacity(0.1), blurRadius: 20),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text('ENTER AMOUNT',
            style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
              fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 2,
              color: AppColors.textHint,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Row(
            children: [
              Text('₹',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize: 36, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: color,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: TextField(
                  controller  : _amountCtrl,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  style       : GoogleFonts.poppins(
                    fontSize: 36, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: AppColors.textPrimary,
                  ),
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText : '0',
                    hintStyle: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                      fontSize: 36, color: AppColors.textHint,
                    ),
                    border: InputBorder.none,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMerchantField() {
    return _inputCard(
      child: TextField(
        controller: _merchantCtrl,
        style     : GoogleFonts.poppins(color: AppColors.textPrimary),
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          hintText  : 'Merchant / Shop name',
          hintStyle : GoogleFonts.poppins(color: AppColors.textHint),
          border    : InputBorder.none,
          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.store_outlined,
            color: AppColors.magenta),
          labelText : 'Merchant',
          labelStyle: GoogleFonts.poppins(color: AppColors.textHint),
          floatingLabelStyle: GoogleFonts.poppins(
            color: AppColors.magenta),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCategoryPicker() {
    return _inputCard(
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.category_outlined,
                color: AppColors.magenta, size: 20),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text('Category',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  color: AppColors.textHint, fontSize: 14,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Wrap(
            spacing   : 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children  : _categories.map((cat) {
              final selected = cat.name == _category;
              return GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => setState(() => _category = cat.name),
                child: AnimatedContainer(
                  duration : const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                  padding  : const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 12, vertical: 8,
                  ),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: selected ? LinearGradient(
                      colors: [
                        AppColors.magenta.withOpacity(0.4),
                        AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.3),
                      ],
                    ) : null,
                    color       : selected ? null : AppColors.background,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: selected
                        ? AppColors.magenta
                        : AppColors.cardBorder,
                    ),
                    boxShadow: selected ? [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color     : AppColors.magenta.withOpacity(0.3),
                        blurRadius: 8,
                      ),
                    ] : null,
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Text(cat.emoji,
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Text(cat.name,
                        style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                          fontSize  : 12,
                          color     : selected
                            ? Colors.white
                            : AppColors.textSecondary,
                          fontWeight: selected
                            ? FontWeight.w600
                            : FontWeight.normal,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              );
            }).toList(),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDatePicker() {
    return _inputCard(
      child: ListTile(
        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        leading: Container(
          padding   : const EdgeInsets.all(8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color       : AppColors.magenta.withOpacity(0.15),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
          ),
          child: const Icon(Icons.calendar_today_rounded,
            color: AppColors.magenta, size: 20),
        ),
        title: Text(
          DateFormat('dd MMMM yyyy').format(_date),
          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
            color: AppColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 14,
          ),
        ),
        subtitle: Text('Tap to change date',
          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
            color: AppColors.textHint, fontSize: 11,
          ),
        ),
        trailing: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded,
          size: 14, color: AppColors.textHint),
        onTap: () async {
          final picked = await showDatePicker(
            context    : context,
            initialDate: _date,
            firstDate  : DateTime(2020),
            lastDate   : DateTime.now(),
            builder    : (ctx, child) => Theme(
              data: ThemeData.dark().copyWith(
                colorScheme: const ColorScheme.dark(
                  primary: AppColors.magenta,
                  surface: AppColors.cardBg,
                ),
              ),
              child: child!,
            ),
          );
          if (picked != null) setState(() => _date = picked);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNoteField() {
    return _inputCard(
      child: TextField(
        controller: _noteCtrl,
        maxLines  : 3,
        style     : GoogleFonts.poppins(color: AppColors.textPrimary),
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          hintText  : 'Add a note (optional)',
          hintStyle : GoogleFonts.poppins(color: AppColors.textHint),
          border    : InputBorder.none,
          labelText : 'Note',
          labelStyle: GoogleFonts.poppins(color: AppColors.textHint),
          floatingLabelStyle: GoogleFonts.poppins(
            color: AppColors.magenta),
          prefixIcon: const Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 40),
            child  : Icon(Icons.note_alt_outlined,
              color: AppColors.magenta),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSaveButton() {
    final color = _isExpense ? AppColors.expense : AppColors.income;
    return SizedBox(
      width : double.infinity,
      height: 56,
      child : DecoratedBox(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            colors: [AppColors.primary, color.withOpacity(0.8)],
          ),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color     : AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.4),
              blurRadius: 15,
              offset    : const Offset(0, 4),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: ElevatedButton(
          onPressed: _saveTransaction,
          style    : ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
            shadowColor    : Colors.transparent,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            ),
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.save_rounded, color: Colors.white),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text('SAVE TRANSACTION',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize     : 15,
                  fontWeight   : FontWeight.bold,
                  color        : Colors.white,
                  letterSpacing: 1,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _inputCard({required Widget child}) {
    return Container(
      width  : double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color       : AppColors.cardBg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border      : Border.all(color: AppColors.cardBorder),
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }

  void _saveTransaction() {
    if (_amountCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content        : Text('Please enter amount!',
            style: GoogleFonts.poppins()),
          backgroundColor: AppColors.expense,
          behavior       : SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Row(
          children: [
            const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Colors.white),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text('Transaction saved! ✅',
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins()),
          ],
        ),
        backgroundColor: AppColors.income,
        behavior       : SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
      ),
    );
    Navigator.pop(context);
  }
}
```

```bash
cat > lib/screens/reports_screen.dart << 'EOF'
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
import 'package:fl_chart/fl_chart.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../widgets/glass_card.dart';

class ReportsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ReportsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ReportsScreen> createState() => _ReportsScreenState();
}

class _ReportsScreenState extends State<ReportsScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late TabController _tabCtrl;
  int _touchedIndex = -1;
  String _selectedMonth = 'January 2025';

  final List<String> _months = [
    'November 2024', 'December 2024', 'January 2025'
  ];

  // Category data
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _categories = [
    {'name':'Groceries',     'emoji':'🛒', 'amount':6000,  'color':Color(0xFFFF00FF), 'pct':0.30},
    {'name':'Auto/Cab',      'emoji':'🚗', 'amount':3500,  'color':Color(0xFF3B82F6), 'pct':0.18},
    {'name':'Rent',          'emoji':'🏠', 'amount':8000,  'color':Color(0xFF7C3AED), 'pct':0.26},
    {'name':'Medical',       'emoji':'💊', 'amount':1200,  'color':Color(0xFFEF4444), 'pct':0.10},
    {'name':'Entertainment', 'emoji':'🎭', 'amount':2300,  'color':Color(0xFFF59E0B), 'pct':0.16},
  ];

  // Monthly data for line chart
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _monthly = [
    {'month':'Aug', 'income':45000.0, 'expense':12000.0},
    {'month':'Sep', 'income':52000.0, 'expense':15000.0},
    {'month':'Oct', 'income':48000.0, 'expense':11000.0},
    {'month':'Nov', 'income':58000.0, 'expense':13000.0},
    {'month':'Dec', 'income':55000.0, 'expense':14000.0},
    {'month':'Jan', 'income':58000.0, 'expense':13000.0},
  ];

  // Weekly data for bar chart
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _weekly = [
    {'day':'Mon', 'amount':2500.0},
    {'day':'Tue', 'amount':1200.0},
    {'day':'Wed', 'amount':3800.0},
    {'day':'Thu', 'amount':900.0},
    {'day':'Fri', 'amount':4200.0},
    {'day':'Sat', 'amount':2100.0},
    {'day':'Sun', 'amount':1500.0},
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tabCtrl = TabController(length: 3, vsync: this);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tabCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            _buildHeader(),
            _buildMonthSelector(),
            _buildSummaryCards(),
            _buildTabBar(),
            Expanded(
              child: TabBarView(
                controller: _tabCtrl,
                children: [
                  _buildOverviewTab(),
                  _buildCategoryTab(),
                  _buildTrendsTab(),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Header ─────────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildHeader() {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 0),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Text('Reports',
            style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
              fontSize  : 24,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
            ),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.download_outlined,
              color: AppColors.magenta),
            onPressed: () {},
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Month Selector ─────────────────────────
  Widget _buildMonthSelector() {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Container(
        padding   : const EdgeInsets.all(4),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color       : AppColors.cardBg,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border      : Border.all(color: AppColors.cardBorder),
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: [
            IconButton(
              icon     : const Icon(Icons.chevron_left,
                color: AppColors.textSecondary),
              onPressed: () {},
            ),
            Text(_selectedMonth,
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
            IconButton(
              icon     : const Icon(Icons.chevron_right,
                color: AppColors.textSecondary),
              onPressed: () {},
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Summary Cards ──────────────────────────
  Widget _buildSummaryCards() {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          _summaryCard('MONEY IN',  '₹58,000', '+8.3%', AppColors.income),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          _summaryCard('MONEY OUT', '₹13,000', '+4.1%', AppColors.expense),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          _summaryCard('SAVED',     '₹45,000', '+17%',  AppColors.primary),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _summaryCard(String label, String amount, String change, Color color) {
    return Expanded(
      child: Container(
        padding   : const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color       : AppColors.cardBg,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border      : Border.all(color: color.withOpacity(0.3)),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color     : color.withOpacity(0.1),
              blurRadius: 8,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(label,
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 1,
                color: AppColors.textHint,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(amount,
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize  : 13,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
            Text(change,
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize: 10, color: color,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Tab Bar ────────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildTabBar() {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: TabBar(
        controller : _tabCtrl,
        indicatorColor: AppColors.magenta,
        indicatorWeight: 3,
        labelColor    : AppColors.magenta,
        unselectedLabelColor: AppColors.textHint,
        labelStyle    : GoogleFonts.poppins(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
        unselectedLabelStyle: GoogleFonts.poppins(),
        tabs: const [
          Tab(text: 'Overview'),
          Tab(text: 'Categories'),
          Tab(text: 'Trends'),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Overview Tab ───────────────────────────
  Widget _buildOverviewTab() {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          // Donut Chart
          GlassCard(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text('Spending by Category',
                  style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                    fontSize  : 15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                SizedBox(
                  height: 220,
                  child : PieChart(
                    PieChartData(
                      pieTouchData: PieTouchData(
                        touchCallback: (event, response) {
                          setState(() {
                            _touchedIndex = response?.touchedSection
                              ?.touchedSectionIndex ?? -1;
                          });
                        },
                      ),
                      sections: _categories.asMap().entries.map((e) {
                        final touched = e.key == _touchedIndex;
                        return PieChartSectionData(
                          value    : (e.value['pct'] as double) * 100,
                          color    : e.value['color'] as Color,
                          radius   : touched ? 70 : 60,
                          title    : '${((e.value['pct'] as double) * 100).toInt()}%',
                          titleStyle: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                            fontSize  : touched ? 14 : 11,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color     : Colors.white,
                          ),
                        );
                      }).toList(),
                      centerSpaceRadius: 50,
                      sectionsSpace    : 3,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                // Legend
                Wrap(
                  spacing   : 12,
                  runSpacing: 8,
                  children  : _categories.map((c) => Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        width : 10,
                        height: 10,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color : c['color'] as Color,
                          shape : BoxShape.circle,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 4),
                      Text(c['name'] as String,
                        style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color   : AppColors.textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  )).toList(),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          // Bar Chart
          GlassCard(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text('Weekly Spending',
                  style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                    fontSize  : 15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                SizedBox(
                  height: 180,
                  child : BarChart(
                    BarChartData(
                      alignment: BarChartAlignment.spaceAround,
                      maxY     : 5000,
                      barGroups: _weekly.asMap().entries.map((e) =>
                        BarChartGroupData(
                          x    : e.key,
                          barRods: [
                            BarChartRodData(
                              toY      : e.value['amount'] as double,
                              gradient : LinearGradient(
                                begin : Alignment.bottomCenter,
                                end   : Alignment.topCenter,
                                colors: [
                                  AppColors.primary,
                                  AppColors.magenta,
                                ],
                              ),
                              width        : 16,
                              borderRadius : BorderRadius.circular(6),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ).toList(),
                      titlesData: FlTitlesData(
                        bottomTitles: AxisTitles(
                          sideTitles: SideTitles(
                            showTitles : true,
                            getTitlesWidget: (val, meta) => Text(
                              _weekly[val.toInt()]['day'] as String,
                              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                                fontSize: 11,
                                color   : AppColors.textHint,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        leftTitles  : const AxisTitles(
                          sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                        topTitles   : const AxisTitles(
                          sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                        rightTitles : const AxisTitles(
                          sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                      ),
                      gridData  : FlGridData(
                        drawVerticalLine: false,
                        getDrawingHorizontalLine: (_) => FlLine(
                          color    : AppColors.cardBorder,
                          strokeWidth: 1,
                        ),
                      ),
                      borderData: FlBorderData(show: false),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Category Tab ───────────────────────────
  Widget _buildCategoryTab() {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: GlassCard(
        child: Column(
          children: _categories.map((c) {
            final pct    = c['pct'] as double;
            final color  = c['color'] as Color;
            final amount = c['amount'] as int;
            return Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width : 38,
                            height: 38,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color       : color.withOpacity(0.15),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                              border: Border.all(
                                color: color.withOpacity(0.3)),
                            ),
                            child: Center(
                              child: Text(c['emoji'] as String,
                                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 12),
                          Text(c['name'] as String,
                            style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                              color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                        children: [
                          Text('₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(amount)}',
                            style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                              color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            ),
                          ),
                          Text('${(pct * 100).toInt()}%',
                            style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                              color  : color,
                              fontSize: 12,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                    child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                      value           : pct,
                      backgroundColor : AppColors.cardBorder,
                      valueColor      : AlwaysStoppedAnimation(color),
                      minHeight       : 6,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }).toList(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Trends Tab ─────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildTrendsTab() {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: GlassCard(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text('Income vs Expenses',
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize  : 15,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Row(
              children: [
                _legendDot(AppColors.income,  'Income'),
                const SizedBox(width: 16),
                _legendDot(AppColors.expense, 'Expenses'),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            SizedBox(
              height: 250,
              child : LineChart(
                LineChartData(
                  lineBarsData: [
                    // Income line
                    LineChartBarData(
                      spots: _monthly.asMap().entries.map((e) =>
                        FlSpot(e.key.toDouble(),
                          e.value['income'] as double),
                      ).toList(),
                      isCurved    : true,
                      color       : AppColors.income,
                      barWidth    : 3,
                      dotData     : FlDotData(
                        getDotPainter: (_, __, ___, ____) =>
                          FlDotCirclePainter(
                            radius     : 4,
                            color      : AppColors.income,
                            strokeWidth: 2,
                            strokeColor: AppColors.background,
                          ),
                      ),
                      belowBarData: BarAreaData(
                        show : true,
                        color: AppColors.income.withOpacity(0.1),
                      ),
                    ),
                    // Expense line
                    LineChartBarData(
                      spots: _monthly.asMap().entries.map((e) =>
                        FlSpot(e.key.toDouble(),
                          e.value['expense'] as double),
                      ).toList(),
                      isCurved    : true,
                      color       : AppColors.expense,
                      barWidth    : 3,
                      dotData     : FlDotData(
                        getDotPainter: (_, __, ___, ____) =>
                          FlDotCirclePainter(
                            radius     : 4,
                            color      : AppColors.expense,
                            strokeWidth: 2,
                            strokeColor: AppColors.background,
                          ),
                      ),
                      belowBarData: BarAreaData(
                        show : true,
                        color: AppColors.expense.withOpacity(0.1),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  titlesData: FlTitlesData(
                    bottomTitles: AxisTitles(
                      sideTitles: SideTitles(
                        showTitles: true,
                        getTitlesWidget: (val, meta) => Text(
                          _monthly[val.toInt()]['month'] as String,
                          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                            fontSize: 11,
                            color   : AppColors.textHint,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    leftTitles : const AxisTitles(
                      sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                    topTitles  : const AxisTitles(
                      sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                    rightTitles: const AxisTitles(
                      sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                  ),
                  gridData  : FlGridData(
                    drawVerticalLine: false,
                    getDrawingHorizontalLine: (_) => FlLine(
                      color    : AppColors.cardBorder,
                      strokeWidth: 1,
                    ),
                  ),
                  borderData: FlBorderData(show: false),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _legendDot(Color color, String label) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Container(
          width : 12, height: 12,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: color, shape: BoxShape.circle,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 6),
        Text(label,
          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
            fontSize: 12, color: AppColors.textSecondary,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

## Update Dashboard to Navigate to Reports

```bash
sed -i 's|// Reports|Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const ReportsScreen()));|g' lib/screens/dashboard_screen.dart
```

Add import to dashboard:
```bash
sed -i "s|import 'add_transaction_screen.dart';|import 'add_transaction_screen.dart';\nimport 'reports_screen.dart';|g" lib/screens/dashboard_screen.dart
```

Update bottom nav tap in dashboard — find `_buildBottomNav` and update `onTap`:
```bash
sed -i "s|onTap.*: (i) => setState(() => _selectedIndex = i),|onTap: (i) {\n        setState(() => _selectedIndex = i);\n        if (i == 1) Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const ReportsScreen()));\n      },|g" lib/screens/dashboard_screen.dart
```

```bash
cat > lib/screens/reports_screen.dart << 'EOF'
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
import 'package:fl_chart/fl_chart.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../widgets/glass_card.dart';

class ReportsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ReportsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ReportsScreen> createState() => _ReportsScreenState();
}

class _ReportsScreenState extends State<ReportsScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late TabController _tabCtrl;
  int      _touchedIndex = -1;

  // ── Always start with CURRENT month ────────
  late DateTime _selectedDate;
  late String   _selectedMonth;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tabCtrl = TabController(length: 3, vsync: this);

    // Set to current calendar month automatically
    final now      = DateTime.now();
    _selectedDate  = DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1);
    _selectedMonth = DateFormat('MMMM yyyy').format(_selectedDate);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tabCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ── Navigate months ─────────────────────────
  void _prevMonth() {
    setState(() {
      _selectedDate  = DateTime(_selectedDate.year, _selectedDate.month - 1);
      _selectedMonth = DateFormat('MMMM yyyy').format(_selectedDate);
    });
  }

  void _nextMonth() {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    // Dont allow future months
    if (_selectedDate.year == now.year &&
        _selectedDate.month == now.month) return;
    setState(() {
      _selectedDate  = DateTime(_selectedDate.year, _selectedDate.month + 1);
      _selectedMonth = DateFormat('MMMM yyyy').format(_selectedDate);
    });
  }

  bool get _isCurrentMonth {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    return _selectedDate.year  == now.year &&
           _selectedDate.month == now.month;
  }

  // ── Category data ───────────────────────────
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _categories = [
    {'name':'Groceries',     'emoji':'🛒', 'amount':6000,  'color':Color(0xFFFF00FF), 'pct':0.30},
    {'name':'Auto/Cab',      'emoji':'🚗', 'amount':3500,  'color':Color(0xFF3B82F6), 'pct':0.18},
    {'name':'Rent',          'emoji':'🏠', 'amount':8000,  'color':Color(0xFF7C3AED), 'pct':0.26},
    {'name':'Medical',       'emoji':'💊', 'amount':1200,  'color':Color(0xFFEF4444), 'pct':0.10},
    {'name':'Entertainment', 'emoji':'🎭', 'amount':2300,  'color':Color(0xFFF59E0B), 'pct':0.16},
  ];

  // ── Last 6 months for line chart ────────────
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get _monthly {
    final now    = DateTime.now();
    return List.generate(6, (i) {
      final month = DateTime(now.year, now.month - 5 + i);
      return {
        'month'  : DateFormat('MMM').format(month),
        'income' : [45000.0, 52000.0, 48000.0, 58000.0, 55000.0, 58000.0][i],
        'expense': [12000.0, 15000.0, 11000.0, 13000.0, 14000.0, 13000.0][i],
      };
    });
  }

  // ── Weekly data ─────────────────────────────
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _weekly = [
    {'day':'Mon', 'amount':2500.0},
    {'day':'Tue', 'amount':1200.0},
    {'day':'Wed', 'amount':3800.0},
    {'day':'Thu', 'amount':900.0},
    {'day':'Fri', 'amount':4200.0},
    {'day':'Sat', 'amount':2100.0},
    {'day':'Sun', 'amount':1500.0},
  ];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            _buildHeader(),
            _buildMonthSelector(),
            _buildSummaryCards(),
            _buildTabBar(),
            Expanded(
              child: TabBarView(
                controller: _tabCtrl,
                children: [
                  _buildOverviewTab(),
                  _buildCategoryTab(),
                  _buildTrendsTab(),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Header ──────────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildHeader() {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 0),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text('Reports',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize  : 24,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                ),
              ),
              Text('Financial Overview',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color   : AppColors.textHint,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          Row(
            children: [
              // Current month badge
              if (_isCurrentMonth)
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color       : AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.2),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.4)),
                  ),
                  child: Text('Current',
                    style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                      fontSize: 11,
                      color   : AppColors.primary,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              IconButton(
                icon     : const Icon(Icons.download_outlined,
                  color: AppColors.magenta),
                onPressed: () {},
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Month Selector ──────────────────────────
  Widget _buildMonthSelector() {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Container(
        padding   : const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 4),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color       : AppColors.cardBg,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border      : Border.all(color: AppColors.cardBorder),
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: [
            // Prev month
            IconButton(
              icon     : const Icon(Icons.chevron_left,
                color: AppColors.textSecondary),
              onPressed: _prevMonth,
            ),
            // Month + Year
            Column(
              children: [
                Text(_selectedMonth,
                  style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                    color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    fontSize  : 15,
                  ),
                ),
                if (_isCurrentMonth)
                  Text('This Month',
                    style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                      fontSize: 10,
                      color   : AppColors.income,
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            // Next month (disabled if current)
            IconButton(
              icon: Icon(Icons.chevron_right,
                color: _isCurrentMonth
                  ? AppColors.cardBorder
                  : AppColors.textSecondary,
              ),
              onPressed: _isCurrentMonth ? null : _nextMonth,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Summary Cards ────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildSummaryCards() {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          _summaryCard('MONEY IN',  '₹58,000', '+8.3%', AppColors.income),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          _summaryCard('MONEY OUT', '₹13,000', '+4.1%', AppColors.expense),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          _summaryCard('SAVED',     '₹45,000', '+17%',  AppColors.primary),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _summaryCard(String label, String amount, String change, Color color) {
    return Expanded(
      child: Container(
        padding   : const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color       : AppColors.cardBg,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border      : Border.all(color: color.withOpacity(0.3)),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color     : color.withOpacity(0.1),
              blurRadius: 8,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(label,
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 1,
                color: AppColors.textHint,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(amount,
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize  : 13,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
            Text(change,
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize: 10, color: color,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Tab Bar ──────────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildTabBar() {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
      child: TabBar(
        controller          : _tabCtrl,
        indicatorColor      : AppColors.magenta,
        indicatorWeight     : 3,
        labelColor          : AppColors.magenta,
        unselectedLabelColor: AppColors.textHint,
        labelStyle          : GoogleFonts.poppins(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
        unselectedLabelStyle: GoogleFonts.poppins(),
        tabs: const [
          Tab(text: 'Overview'),
          Tab(text: 'Categories'),
          Tab(text: 'Trends'),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Overview Tab ─────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildOverviewTab() {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          // Donut Chart
          GlassCard(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: [
                    Text('Spending by Category',
                      style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                        fontSize  : 15,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Text(_selectedMonth,
                      style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        color   : AppColors.textHint,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                SizedBox(
                  height: 220,
                  child : PieChart(
                    PieChartData(
                      pieTouchData: PieTouchData(
                        touchCallback: (event, response) {
                          setState(() {
                            _touchedIndex = response
                              ?.touchedSection
                              ?.touchedSectionIndex ?? -1;
                          });
                        },
                      ),
                      sections: _categories.asMap().entries.map((e) {
                        final touched = e.key == _touchedIndex;
                        return PieChartSectionData(
                          value    : (e.value['pct'] as double) * 100,
                          color    : e.value['color'] as Color,
                          radius   : touched ? 70 : 60,
                          title    : '${((e.value['pct'] as double) * 100).toInt()}%',
                          titleStyle: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                            fontSize  : touched ? 14 : 11,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color     : Colors.white,
                          ),
                        );
                      }).toList(),
                      centerSpaceRadius: 50,
                      sectionsSpace    : 3,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                Wrap(
                  spacing   : 12,
                  runSpacing: 8,
                  children  : _categories.map((c) => Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        width : 10, height: 10,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: c['color'] as Color,
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 4),
                      Text(c['name'] as String,
                        style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color   : AppColors.textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  )).toList(),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          // Bar Chart
          GlassCard(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: [
                    Text('Weekly Spending',
                      style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                        fontSize  : 15,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Text('This Week',
                      style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        color   : AppColors.textHint,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                SizedBox(
                  height: 180,
                  child : BarChart(
                    BarChartData(
                      alignment: BarChartAlignment.spaceAround,
                      maxY     : 5000,
                      barGroups: _weekly.asMap().entries.map((e) =>
                        BarChartGroupData(
                          x       : e.key,
                          barRods : [
                            BarChartRodData(
                              toY     : e.value['amount'] as double,
                              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                                begin : Alignment.bottomCenter,
                                end   : Alignment.topCenter,
                                colors: [AppColors.primary, AppColors.magenta],
                              ),
                              width       : 16,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ).toList(),
                      titlesData: FlTitlesData(
                        bottomTitles: AxisTitles(
                          sideTitles: SideTitles(
                            showTitles     : true,
                            getTitlesWidget: (val, meta) => Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                              child  : Text(
                                _weekly[val.toInt()]['day'] as String,
                                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                                  fontSize: 11,
                                  color   : AppColors.textHint,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        leftTitles  : const AxisTitles(
                          sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                        topTitles   : const AxisTitles(
                          sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                        rightTitles : const AxisTitles(
                          sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                      ),
                      gridData : FlGridData(
                        drawVerticalLine       : false,
                        getDrawingHorizontalLine: (_) => FlLine(
                          color      : AppColors.cardBorder,
                          strokeWidth: 1,
                        ),
                      ),
                      borderData: FlBorderData(show: false),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Category Tab ─────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildCategoryTab() {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: GlassCard(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text('$_selectedMonth Breakdown',
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize  : 15,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            ..._categories.map((c) {
              final pct    = c['pct']    as double;
              final color  = c['color']  as Color;
              final amount = c['amount'] as int;
              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Row(
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              width : 38, height: 38,
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color       : color.withOpacity(0.15),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: color.withOpacity(0.3)),
                              ),
                              child: Center(
                                child: Text(c['emoji'] as String,
                                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 12),
                            Text(c['name'] as String,
                              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                                color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              '₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(amount)}',
                              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                                color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                            ),
                            Text('${(pct * 100).toInt()}%',
                              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                                color  : color,
                                fontSize: 12,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    ClipRRect(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                      child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                        value          : pct,
                        backgroundColor: AppColors.cardBorder,
                        valueColor     : AlwaysStoppedAnimation(color),
                        minHeight      : 6,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Trends Tab ────────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildTrendsTab() {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: GlassCard(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text('6 Month Trend',
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize  : 15,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text('Income vs Expenses',
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize: 12,
                color   : AppColors.textHint,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              children: [
                _legendDot(AppColors.income,  'Income'),
                const SizedBox(width: 16),
                _legendDot(AppColors.expense, 'Expenses'),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            SizedBox(
              height: 250,
              child : LineChart(
                LineChartData(
                  lineBarsData: [
                    LineChartBarData(
                      spots: _monthly.asMap().entries.map((e) =>
                        FlSpot(e.key.toDouble(),
                          e.value['income'] as double),
                      ).toList(),
                      isCurved    : true,
                      color       : AppColors.income,
                      barWidth    : 3,
                      dotData     : FlDotData(
                        getDotPainter: (_, __, ___, ____) =>
                          FlDotCirclePainter(
                            radius     : 4,
                            color      : AppColors.income,
                            strokeWidth: 2,
                            strokeColor: AppColors.background,
                          ),
                      ),
                      belowBarData: BarAreaData(
                        show : true,
                        color: AppColors.income.withOpacity(0.1),
                      ),
                    ),
                    LineChartBarData(
                      spots: _monthly.asMap().entries.map((e) =>
                        FlSpot(e.key.toDouble(),
                          e.value['expense'] as double),
                      ).toList(),
                      isCurved    : true,
                      color       : AppColors.expense,
                      barWidth    : 3,
                      dotData     : FlDotData(
                        getDotPainter: (_, __, ___, ____) =>
                          FlDotCirclePainter(
                            radius     : 4,
                            color      : AppColors.expense,
                            strokeWidth: 2,
                            strokeColor: AppColors.background,
                          ),
                      ),
                      belowBarData: BarAreaData(
                        show : true,
                        color: AppColors.expense.withOpacity(0.1),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  titlesData: FlTitlesData(
                    bottomTitles: AxisTitles(
                      sideTitles: SideTitles(
                        showTitles     : true,
                        getTitlesWidget: (val, meta) => Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                          child  : Text(
                            _monthly[val.toInt()]['month'] as String,
                            style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color   : AppColors.textHint,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    leftTitles  : const AxisTitles(
                      sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                    topTitles   : const AxisTitles(
                      sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                    rightTitles : const AxisTitles(
                      sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
                  ),
                  gridData  : FlGridData(
                    drawVerticalLine       : false,
                    getDrawingHorizontalLine: (_) => FlLine(
                      color      : AppColors.cardBorder,
                      strokeWidth: 1,
                    ),
                  ),
                  borderData: FlBorderData(show: false),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _legendDot(Color color, String label) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Container(
          width : 12, height: 12,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: color, shape: BoxShape.circle,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 6),
        Text(label,
          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
            fontSize: 12, color: AppColors.textSecondary,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

```bash
cat > lib/screens/budget_screen.dart << 'EOF'
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../widgets/glass_card.dart';

class BudgetScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const BudgetScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<BudgetScreen> createState() => _BudgetScreenState();
}

class _BudgetScreenState extends State<BudgetScreen> {
  String get _currentMonth =>
    DateFormat('MMMM yyyy').format(DateTime.now());

  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _budgets = [
    {'name':'Groceries',    'emoji':'🛒', 'spent':6000,  'limit':8000,  'color':Color(0xFFFF00FF)},
    {'name':'Auto/Cab',     'emoji':'🚗', 'spent':3500,  'limit':5000,  'color':Color(0xFF3B82F6)},
    {'name':'Rent',         'emoji':'🏠', 'spent':8000,  'limit':8000,  'color':Color(0xFF7C3AED)},
    {'name':'Medical',      'emoji':'💊', 'spent':1200,  'limit':3000,  'color':Color(0xFFEF4444)},
    {'name':'Entertainment','emoji':'🎭', 'spent':4500,  'limit':3000,  'color':Color(0xFFF59E0B)},
    {'name':'Shopping',     'emoji':'🛍️', 'spent':2000,  'limit':5000,  'color':Color(0xFF06B6D4)},
    {'name':'Mobile/DTH',   'emoji':'📱', 'spent':999,   'limit':1500,  'color':Color(0xFF10B981)},
    {'name':'Electricity',  'emoji':'⚡', 'spent':2200,  'limit':2500,  'color':Color(0xFFEAB308)},
  ];

  double get _totalBudget  =>
    _budgets.fold(0, (s, b) => s + (b['limit'] as int));
  double get _totalSpent   =>
    _budgets.fold(0, (s, b) => s + (b['spent'] as int));
  double get _totalRemain  => _totalBudget - _totalSpent;
  double get _overallPct   =>
    (_totalSpent / _totalBudget).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

  Color _statusColor(int spent, int limit) {
    final pct = spent / limit;
    if (pct >= 1.0)  return AppColors.expense;
    if (pct >= 0.8)  return AppColors.warning;
    return AppColors.income;
  }

  String _statusLabel(int spent, int limit) {
    final pct = spent / limit;
    if (pct >= 1.0)  return 'Over budget!';
    if (pct >= 0.8)  return 'Almost full';
    return 'On track';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            _buildHeader(),
            Expanded(
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    _buildOverallCard(),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    _buildBudgetList(),
                    const SizedBox(height: 80),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
        onPressed  : _showAddBudgetDialog,
        backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
        icon  : const Icon(Icons.add, color: Colors.white),
        label : Text('Add Budget',
          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
            color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Header ────────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildHeader() {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 0),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text('Budget',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize  : 24,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                ),
              ),
              Text(_currentMonth,
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color   : AppColors.textHint,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color       : AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.2),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              border: Border.all(
                color: AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.4)),
            ),
            child: Text('This Month',
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize: 12,
                color   : AppColors.primary,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Overall Budget Card ───────────────────
  Widget _buildOverallCard() {
    return Container(
      width  : double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(22),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin : Alignment.topLeft,
          end   : Alignment.bottomRight,
          colors: [
            AppColors.cardBg,
            AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.15),
          ],
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(
          color: AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.3)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color     : AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.1),
            blurRadius: 20,
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text('TOTAL BUDGET',
            style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
              fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 2,
              color: AppColors.textHint,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text('₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(_totalBudget)}',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize  : 32,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                ),
              ),
              Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                children: [
                  Text('Spent',
                    style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                      fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.textHint)),
                  Text('₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(_totalSpent)}',
                    style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                      fontSize  : 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color     : AppColors.expense,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          // Overall progress
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
            child: LinearProgressIndicator(
              value          : _overallPct,
              backgroundColor: AppColors.cardBorder,
              valueColor     : AlwaysStoppedAnimation(
                _overallPct >= 1.0
                  ? AppColors.expense
                  : _overallPct >= 0.8
                    ? AppColors.warning
                    : AppColors.primary,
              ),
              minHeight: 10,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text('${(_overallPct * 100).toInt()}% used',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize: 12, color: AppColors.textSecondary)),
              Text(
                _totalRemain >= 0
                  ? '₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(_totalRemain)} remaining'
                  : '₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(_totalRemain.abs())} over budget!',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color   : _totalRemain >= 0
                    ? AppColors.income
                    : AppColors.expense,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          // Quick stats row
          Row(
            children: [
              _quickStat('On Track',
                '${_budgets.where((b) => (b['spent'] as int) / (b['limit'] as int) < 0.8).length}',
                AppColors.income),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              _quickStat('Warning',
                '${_budgets.where((b) {
                  final p = (b['spent'] as int) / (b['limit'] as int);
                  return p >= 0.8 && p < 1.0;
                }).length}',
                AppColors.warning),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              _quickStat('Over Budget',
                '${_budgets.where((b) => (b['spent'] as int) >= (b['limit'] as int)).length}',
                AppColors.expense),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _quickStat(String label, String count, Color color) {
    return Expanded(
      child: Container(
        padding   : const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color       : color.withOpacity(0.1),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          border: Border.all(color: color.withOpacity(0.3)),
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Text(count,
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize  : 18,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color     : color,
              ),
            ),
            Text(label,
              style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                fontSize: 10,
                color   : AppColors.textHint,
              ),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Budget List ───────────────────────────
  Widget _buildBudgetList() {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text('Category Budgets',
          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
            fontSize  : 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        ..._budgets.map((b) => _budgetItem(b)),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _budgetItem(Map<String, dynamic> b) {
    final spent  = b['spent']  as int;
    final limit  = b['limit']  as int;
    final color  = b['color']  as Color;
    final pct    = (spent / limit).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final status = _statusColor(spent, limit);
    final remain = limit - spent;

    return GlassCard(
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    width : 44, height: 44,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color       : color.withOpacity(0.15),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: color.withOpacity(0.3)),
                    ),
                    child: Center(
                      child: Text(b['emoji'] as String,
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20)),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(b['name'] as String,
                        style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                          color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          fontSize  : 14,
                        ),
                      ),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color       : status.withOpacity(0.15),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                        ),
                        child: Text(_statusLabel(spent, limit),
                          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                            fontSize: 10, color: status,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                children: [
                  RichText(
                    text: TextSpan(
                      children: [
                        TextSpan(
                          text : '₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(spent)}',
                          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                            color     : AppColors.textPrimary,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            fontSize  : 14,
                          ),
                        ),
                        TextSpan(
                          text : ' / ₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(limit)}',
                          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                            color  : AppColors.textHint,
                            fontSize: 12,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  Text(
                    remain >= 0
                      ? '₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(remain)} left'
                      : '₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(remain.abs())} over!',
                    style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                      fontSize: 11,
                      color   : status,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Stack(
            children: [
              Container(
                height    : 8,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color       : AppColors.cardBorder,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                ),
              ),
              FractionallySizedBox(
                widthFactor: pct,
                child: Container(
                  height    : 8,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                      colors: [color, status],
                    ),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                    boxShadow: [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color     : status.withOpacity(0.4),
                        blurRadius: 4,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text('${(pct * 100).toInt()}% used',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.textHint)),
              Text('Budget: ₹${NumberFormat('#,##,###').format(limit)}',
                style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
                  fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.textHint)),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Add Budget Dialog ─────────────────────
  void _showAddBudgetDialog() {
    final nameCtrl  = TextEditingController();
    final limitCtrl = TextEditingController();
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: AppColors.cardBg,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Text('Add Budget',
          style: GoogleFonts.poppins(
            color: AppColors.textPrimary,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          ),
        ),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            TextField(
```
